_about: Gemini TTS casting for render_pages_gemini.py. Lookup: courses[course][speaker], then default[speaker], then default.woman. voice = a prebuilt voice name or a voice-library id (GET v1beta/voices, e.g. en-gb-*); style = speechMetadata.style (turn-level delivery, never read aloud). Keep a character's voice and style fixed across chapters: changing either one re-voices every line of that character. run: true = all of this character's lines on a page are synthesized as ONE request and cut apart by forced alignment, which keeps a prebuilt voice from drifting between lines (render_pages_gemini.py, same-speaker runs); keep style short (no age, accent or biography: ai.google.dev speech-generation names long style blocks as the main cause of voice drift). gender: "f" or "m" (from the casting and the text), used by the voice gate (tools/voice_gate.py) to flag a line or a character whose pitch reads as the other gender; no field = no pitch check. sim_min, tone_sim_min, pitch_max_st: optional per-character voice-gate bars (tools/voice_gate.py reads them; no field = the gate defaults 0.88 / 0.85 / no pitch-spread check). Main characters carry sim_min 0.92 and tone_sim_min 0.88: they are heard page after page, and drift between pages that clears 0.88 is still audible (2026-10-12, Abby in pilot ch1).
